about: The graduale of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass during the Night” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: With You is dominion in the day of Your power; in the splendors of the saints, from the womb before the day-star I begot You. The Lord said to my Lord: Sit at My right hand, until I make Your enemies the footstool of Your feet.
